All 35 embedded catalogs under providers/catalog/*.json are generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-catalogs` from a SINGLE pi revision — pi@b0c2a90e (2026-07-17T09:00:03Z) — so `generatedAt` and `source` describe every file, and `catalogs` below records the per-provider source module so a future split cannot be hidden behind one value (PROV-060). PROV-039: the value must be the LATEST extraction revision. IRREDUCIBLE RESIDUE (PROV-060), stated here and not only in the ledger: b0c2a90e is 13 days EARLIER than the ported tag v0.83.0 (2026-07-30). Any claim of catalog parity at v0.83.0 is a claim about b0c2a90e plus an unbounded delta.
